text:
alex: Kicking off coordinated staging deploy for release v2.4.0 — planning pin+canary across API/runtime/console/router. Quiet window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Services and pins:
- API: v2.4.0
- runtime: v2.4.0-rc2 (quantized build)
- console: v2.4.0-schema (client bump required)
- router: header-split + routing v1.8

alex: @maya can you confirm the migration is read-only and safe at 22:05?

maya: migration is read-only. I'll run `pg_dump --schema-only` preflight and watch locks. No writes expected. :+1:

jen: propose canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 12–15m observation windows. If regressions, immediate rollback to previous pinned versions.

sam: console schema is additive but old clients will be unaffected. router flag `enable-header-split` must be off for wave1 canary. We'll flip it in wave2.

deploy-bot: Received pin request from alex. To proceed run:
```
deploy-bot pin --service api --version v2.4.0 --wave staging
deploy-bot pin --service runtime --version v2.4.0-rc2 --wave staging
```

leo: rollback thresholds suggestion: error rate > 2% for 5 minutes OR p50 latency increase > 40% OR p95 > 300ms. Also auto-fallback to cpu-only variant if gpu pool OOM.

maya: agreed on thresholds. I'll own migration window and preflight logs. @alex I'll post the migration checklist 21:30 UTC.

alex: I'll trigger preflight at 21:45 — deploy-bot, please dry-run pins and smoke tests. If all green, start wave1 at 22:00 with router flag OFF.

deploy-bot: Dry-run complete. Smoke tests: PASS (api/runtime/console/route). Pins staged.

jen: :thumbsup: I'll monitor traces and feature flags. If any anomalies within wave1, we hold and rollback.

alex: final plan noted. holding doc link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-v2.4.0-staging

sam: on-call pagers are primed. tagging @ops on-call.

alex: thanks team — see you for preflight. Once pinned I'll announce in #release-handoff.
